# Forecast study summary (generated by experiments/forecast/summarize.py; tables only)

# Multi-scale forecasting evaluation

Source: `multiscale.json` (script `experiments/forecast/multiscale.py`, git `bb12439ac0`, data kind mixed). Hardware: Google Colab CPU runtime, High-RAM shape, 8 vCPU, Python 3.13. Run time 182 s.

Entries are estimate [95% bootstrap CI over windows (origins)]. WQL = 2 x mean pinball loss (21 levels) / mean |y|. MASE = MAE of the median / in-context seasonal-naive MAE. cov80 and cov98 are the empirical coverage of the 10-90% and 1-99% quantile intervals. Rows labelled SIMULATED use gpu_stack heatwave simulator data. Timestral rows are zero-shot, without covariates.

## Protocol

| scale | context (steps) | horizon (steps) | season (steps) | buckets (steps) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| seconds | 256 | 300 | 1 | 1-10s=1-10, 11-60s=11-60, 61-180s=61-180, 181-300s=181-300 |
| minutes | 96 | 60 | 1 | 1-5min=1-5, 6-15min=6-15, 16-30min=16-30, 31-60min=31-60 |
| hours | 96 | 48 | 24 | 1-6h=1-6, 7-24h=7-24, 25-48h=25-48 |

Timestral 209M: equally spaced subsample of up to 120 windows per dataset; all methods are also scored on that subset in the 209M subset tables.

# Hierarchy coherence adjustment

Source: `hierarchy.json` (script `experiments/forecast/hierarchy.py`, git `bb12439ac0`, data kind mixed). Hardware: Google Colab CPU runtime, High-RAM shape, 8 vCPU, Python 3.13. Run time 1443 s.

Variants: base (independent forecasts), bottom_up, ols, mint_shrink (MinT, shrinkage covariance of median errors at steps 1-10 on training windows), mint_shrink_allh (same with all 300 steps). Quantile levels are adjusted one at a time with the same matrix (approximation). Coherence error = sum |y_A - sum of bottom series below A| / sum |y_A| per aggregate level. Trees labelled SIMULATED use gpu_stack heatwave simulator data.

Context 256 s, horizon 300 s. Sim test seeds [100, 101, 102, 103, 104, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109]; MinT covariance from validation seeds [50, 51, 52, 53].
